body:
I looked a bit into this. This line is weird:

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/3fef47b41c98392865d13fd21bbcec34236daf4f/services/context/user.go#L40

If the user has a dot in their name, it returns `username.rss` instead of `username`. Perhaps, a maintainer could say why this happens?
Got this problem while adding a new package type. I found the issue but I'm not sure what could be a solution. I have created an issue: https://github.com/go-chi/chi/issues/781

> Got this problem while adding a new package type. I found the issue but I'm not sure what could be a solution. I have created an issue: [go-chi/chi#781](https://github.com/go-chi/chi/issues/781)

Definitely seems a 'same' situation. In your case, greedy seems best, assuming there is always a `.extension`.
